captions.detailed: This 3D model features a desk-mountable USB fan with a clean, uniform light gray finish. It consists of a C-clamp base designed for flat surfaces, a straight vertical support rod, and a circular fan housing at the top. On the lower rear side of the fan housing, a small circular speed dial is present, allowing for manual adjustment.
captions.instruction: Generate a desk-mountable USB fan with a C-clamp base, a vertical support rod, and a circular fan housing. Include a small speed dial on the rear lower section of the fan housing, and ensure all parts have a uniform light gray material.
captions.factory: The model is built using CadQuery primitive shapes. First, the base is created by subtracting an inner box from a larger outer box to form a C-clamp shape. The vertical rod is constructed using a cylinder, which is joined to the clamp base with a small flared flange. The fan head is designed by subtracting a cylinder from a larger cylinder to create a hollowed-out ring housing, complete with a back cover. Finally, the speed dial is modeled as a small thin cylinder positioned on the lower rear portion of the fan head.
